id: title:arthurdedeus:allow account system tables in materializations

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse access control and reserved-system-name filtering implementation.
review.reason: The chunk implements warehouse access control allowlists and reserved-system-name filtering. P1.F6.H1 defines the allowlist, P1.F7.H2 and P1.F8.H2 propagate it to warehouse database creation and managed viewsets, and P1.F2.H6 and P1.F4.H2 apply the filtering and pass the allowlist. This establishes a bounded, substantive capability for warehouse access enforcement.
review.uncertainty: Tier 3 requires broader systemic benefit or systemic risk reduction demonstrated across components, which is not established by this chunk alone. Tier 1 is too low given the implementation of a critical access control mechanism. The score relies on the observed implementation and propagation, not unverified adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and test changes. The implementation changes are in P1.F2 and P1.F4, while P1.F3 and P1.F5 are tests. No score is assigned.
